The '''Warcarrier''' was a [[Bomber/Legends|bomber]] model manufactured by [[Elsinore-Cordova Engineering]] for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] that saw use during the [[Galactic War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. Primarily a drone bomber, the Warcarrier carried drones, [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]], and various missiles or torpedoes depending on its loadout.<ref name="GS" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Warcarrier is one of the four bomber models available to Republic players in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Galactic Starfighter]]'', a [[2013]] Digital Expansion to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. It costs 5,000 Fleet Requisition to unlock, and is the Republic faction's drone bomber, deploying repair, missile, and sentry drones. Its Imperial counterpart is the [[B-4D Legion]].<ref name="GS" />
